newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 5.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 5.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Hungarin farmers' protest, due to their small scale, remained mostly symbolic today.
- Farmers' association MAGOSZ said there is little chance of an agreemnt with government representatives on Wednesday, while the Finance Ministry said they will keep its promises.
- Russia's senate passed a bill that keeps artworks looted during World War II, including some of Hungarian origin, as Russian state property.
- The National Bank of Hungary will isue 50 billion yens worth of samurai bonds.
- There is a 14-hour truck queue at the Austrian border.
- Postabank's management is pondering whether to offer a bonus to clients who remained with the bank during last week's run or to gain back customers who left during it.
